description: Vulnerability in the JD Edwards EnterpriseOne Localizations product of Oracle JD Edwards (component: LATAM).   The supported version that is affected is 9.2. Easily exploitable vulnerability allows low privileged attacker with network access via JDENET to compromise JD Edwards EnterpriseOne Localizations.  Successful attacks of this vulnerability can result in  unauthorized read access to a subset of JD Edwards EnterpriseOne Localizations accessible data and unauthorized ability to cause a partial denial of service (partial DOS) of JD Edwards EnterpriseOne Localizations. CVSS 3.1 Base Score 5.4 (Confidentiality and Availability impacts).  CVSS Vector: (CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:L/UI:N/S:U/C:L/I:N/A:L).
